name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Technical Implementation Specialist | SaaS Onboarding, API Integrations, Tracking & Attribution
summary: Technical implementation lead who takes customers from kickoff to go-live and gets the data right. At Solenzo I configure client systems end to end: Google Tag Manager, GA4 events, Meta Pixel and Google Ads conversion tags, UTM conventions, and CRM data feeds, connected with webhooks, REST APIs, OAuth credentials, and JavaScript/Python code steps in n8n, Make, and Zapier. Before that, 15+ years of SaaS implementation: 25+ launches per month at 110% of implementation targets at Wix (including e-commerce builds for retail brands), technical onboarding at Birdeye, and implementation plans and API integrations at Accelo.

experience.title: Technical Implementation & Marketing Technology — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead end-to-end client implementations from kickoff to go-live, translating business requirements into system configuration and workflows, then training the team that runs them.
Build integrations in n8n, Make, and Zapier with OAuth and API-key credentials, webhooks, REST API calls, and JSON payloads, debugging failures myself.
Set up and validate data feeds and imports into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, re-checking every import so records arrive intact.
Deploy Google Tag Manager with custom triggers and variables for GA4 events, Meta Pixel, and Google Ads conversions; enforce UTM conventions and configure cookie consent.
Debug tracking with GTM Preview and browser DevTools (network tab, dataLayer), and write SQL for BigQuery/GA4 pulls and Power BI models.
Document every configuration and deliverable in Notion, reusing a shared template base instead of starting from scratch.
